L: Hi everyone! Next year is going to be big for me, so let's talk about my plans.
First, I'm gonna save some money, because I'd love to travel in the summer.
Second, I'll start learning to drive.
I'm a little scared, but my uncle says he'll teach me.
If I work hard, I might finally get my license by September.
Third, I want to take a cooking class, since I can't even boil an egg properly.
Honestly, I used to think plans were boring, but now I feel excited about the future.
So tell me in the comments: what are your plans for next year? Catch you next time!
